How this compares in the UK

UK agencies typically charge from £50 to £150 a month for website care, and specialist app studios charge £675 to £1,495 a month for app maintenance.

Frequently asked questions

How much does website management cost?

Website management starts at £49 a month for Care, £69 a month for the Build Fellow (including a 5-page custom site) and £159 a month for Care Plus.

How much does app maintenance cost?

App management starts at £149 a month for App Care, £359 for App Care Plus and £599 for App Care Pro.

Is there a contract?

Plans are billed monthly. You can move up or down a plan from the next month.

Can you look after a website or app you didn't build?

Yes. We check it first, then take it onto the plan that fits.

Do I need a plan after a development build?

We recommend one so your website or app stays secure, fast and up to date. New builds start on the plan you choose at launch.
